claims.claim: A hand-labeled seed dataset of 48 real public repos across 5 death-modes ships in-repo (10 alive / 10 abandoned / 10 pivoted / 9 completed / 9 burned_out).
The seed CSV is built by the SAME production feature extractor; 2 repos dropped (genuine 404s), 6 recovered via the 301-redirect fix.

TabPFN now runs LOCAL on-device (no Prior Labs dependency); measured leave-one-out accuracy on the 47-row seed = 17/47 = 36.2% (chance = 20%), beating the 1-NN proxy (31%). Modest but real and honestly reported — predicting repo death-mode from 6 features on 47 examples is genuinely hard.
claims.evidence: app/classifier.py (local tabpfn fit/predict); reproduce via the LOO snippet over data/seed_repos.csv

claims.claim: The core AI is open-weight only: TabPFN (open weights, tabular foundation model) classifies LOCALLY on-device; narration is an open-weight LLM (deepseek-v4.1-flash) via 0G Compute decentralized inference. No proprietary model in the core path.
Every verdict carries an engine flag (tabpfn|rules) surfaced verbatim on the certificate; a fallback is labeled 'forensic-rules estimate — model unavailable'.
Narration rejects any 2+-digit number absent from the evidence block (retry once, then templated fallback). The grounding test proves a fabricated 99999 is rejected.
The full local loop runs end-to-end: real repo -> features -> classify -> grounded eulogy -> AutopsyResult JSON; /healthz 200, bad input -> 422, 404 repo -> friendly 422 (no uncaught 500).
All 4 offline test suites pass (14 cases): validators, features, classifier shape, narration grounding.
A 1200x630 certificate screenshot for each of 3 example repos (abandoned / burned_out / alive) for the post cover image.

The app is LIVE and public at https://autopsy.132-145-100-81.sslip.io (co-resident on an Oracle Always-Free micro, systemd, no spin-down). A paste returns engine='tabpfn' (local TabPFN classifying on-box) + a real grounded eulogy from an open-weight LLM via 0G Compute (decentralized, deepseek-v4.1-flash). gemma2:2b-via-Ollama is the local-only path (2.6GB won't fit this micro; restored if an A1 with RAM is obtained).
